name: ST NUCLEO-U575ZI-Q (Nucleo-144)
description: Low-power Cortex-M33 (160 MHz, TrustZone, 2 MB flash, on-chip SMPS) Nucleo-144 with USB-C, Arduino Uno V3 and morpho headers and ST-LINK; good for secure battery designs.
notes: The -Q suffix means the SMPS-equipped STM32U575ZIT6Q. The U575 has no Ethernet MAC, so unlike the H5/H7 Nucleo-144 boards there is no RJ45.
ST-LINK uses a micro-USB port and the user USB port is a separate connector. 100 GPIO is an estimate of what reaches the connectors.
KiCad footprint is the common Nucleo-144 morpho connector footprint (no dedicated symbol for this board).
Price is the ST eStore list price seen in late 2026 (US tariff-era pricing); older articles quote lower numbers, so re-check before ordering.
